growth_stage_information: Panicle initiation and flowering are most sensitive to moisture stress. Requires saturated root zone.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Crown root initiation and flowering/milking are critical stages. Sensitive to deficit during anthesis.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Silking and tasseling are acutely sensitive (Ky=1.25); moisture deficit causes severe yield loss.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Flowering and boll formation are sensitive; water stress induces boll shedding and fiber shortening.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: High water demand throughout vegetative elongation; drought during tillering causes significant loss.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Acutely sensitive to deficit at flowering and fruit setting (Ky=1.10); leads to flower drop and blossom end rot.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Shallow root system with high sensitivity (p=0.35); tuber initiation and bulking require steady moisture.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Extremely shallow rooted with high depletion sensitivity (p=0.30); drying during bulb enlargement cracks bulbs.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Flowering and pod development are sensitive (Ky=1.00-1.10); moisture stress causes flower and pod abortion.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Pegging and pod development are critical stages; dry topsoil inhibits gynophore (peg) penetration.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Highly drought-tolerant deep-rooted pulse (p=0.65); sensitive to excess moisture/waterlogging; critical at flowering.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; ICAR Pulses Water Guide

growth_stage_information: Deep taproot confers strong drought tolerance; moisture deficit during pod formation reduces seed set.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; ICAR Pulses Water Guide

growth_stage_information: Low seasonal water requirement; flowering and siliqua formation are key moisture-sensitive windows.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; ICAR Directorate of Rapeseed-Mustard

growth_stage_information: Drought tolerant with extensive root system; moisture stress at booting and flowering causes high yield loss.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Exceptional drought tolerance (p=0.60); adapted to arid environments; critical during heading/flowering.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; ICAR Millet Directorate

growth_stage_information: Shallow root system with large leaf canopy; sensitive to deficit (p=0.35) during shooting and bunch development.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; FAO Paper 33

growth_stage_information: Deep rooted orchard tree; dry period beneficial for flowering induction, fruit set and expansion require steady moisture.
source_reference: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22; ICAR Orchard Water Guidelines
